title: Heterogeneous transfer learning for high-dimensional regression with feature mismatch
abstract: arXiv:2412.18081v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study Heterogeneous Transfer Learning (HTL) for high-dimensional regression with differing feature sets. Such feature mismatch arises when some variables available in a data-rich source domain are unavailable in a data-poor target domain. Yet most homogeneous TL methods require the same feature space in both the source and target domains, limiting their practical applicability. Conversely, existing HTL methods lack statistical error guarantees, limiting their utility for scientific discovery. We propose an HTL method that first learns a feature map between the missing and observed features leveraging the vast source data, imputes the unavailable features in the target, and then performs a two-step TL for penalized regression. We consider both the linear and the nonparametric feature maps. translated_title: 特征不匹配下高维回归的异构迁移学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究了高维回归中具有不同特征集的异构迁移学习（HTL）。当数据丰富的源域中某些变量在数据贫乏的目标域中不可用时，就会出现这种特征不匹配。然而，大多数同构迁移学习方法要求源域和目标域具有相同的特征空间，限制了其实际应用。相反，现有的异构迁移学习方法缺乏统计误差保证，限制了其在科学发现中的实用性。我们提出了一种异构迁移学习方法，该方法首先利用大量源数据学习缺失特征与观测特征之间的特征映射，对目标域中不可用的特征进行插补，然后对惩罚回归执行两步迁移学习。我们考虑了线性和非参数特征映射。我们开发了HTL估计和预测误差的上界，假设源和目标参数差异稀疏，并...
tldr: 本文提出了一种针对特征不匹配的高维回归异构迁移学习方法，通过特征映射插补和两步迁移学习，提供了统计误差保证，解决了现有方法在特征空间不同时的应用限制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a heterogeneous transfer learning method for high-dimensional regression with feature mismatch, which imputes missing features via feature mapping and performs two-step transfer learning, providing statistical error guarantees to overcome limitations of existing methods when feature spaces differ.
